mainEntity.name: What building codes apply to deck stairs in the Alameda area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck stairs must comply with local building codes regarding rise, run, width, handrail height, and baluster spacing for safety. These codes vary slightly by jurisdiction but generally follow international residential codes. For instance, in Alameda, specific requirements for stringer size and landing dimensions might apply. Process Clarity: Hometelligent Inc. ensures all deck stair projects in our service areas, including Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, and Dublin, meet or exceed local building code standards, handling necessary permits and inspections.
